Both Spring 2027 courses are assumed to meet on **Tuesdays and Thursdays**. **MATH 574 meeting time and room: TBD.** This blank teaching schedule awaits the official timetable and course-content planning.

Dates follow the [Illinois Tech academic calendar](https://www.iit.edu/registrar/academic-calendar), checked September 18, 2026. Week numbers count semester calendar weeks, including Spring Break. Topic and materials cells are intentionally blank.
